context.summary: Liposomes (POPC:DOPE-MCC) loaded with selenium nanoparticles by single-step microfluidics, then surface-coupled to thiolated chitosan (Cs-NAC) for oral Se delivery; characterized by NTA, zeta, TEM, SAXS, PXRD, loading, radical scavenging and mucoadhesion in Caco-2/HT29-MTX and porcine tissue.

context.summary: Keratin-encapsulated cationic liposomes (lecithin, cholesterol, ceramide NP, chitosan) made by high-pressure homogenization to repair UV-damaged hair; liposomes characterized by DLS, cryo-TEM and SAXS, then hair penetration, SEM, protein/lipid assays and FT-IR on hair.
